intro.title: Feel confident talking about cervical screening
intro.description: Practise the follow-up telehealth consultation that takes place after you request an at-home cervical screening self-collection kit. Rehearse the questions a practitioner may ask to check whether at-home self-collection is suitable for you.

privacy.notice: This is a practice session. Do not share personal information or sensitive medical details. The conversation transcript is not saved on this page.

mode.title: Choose how you want to respond
mode.chatDescription: Type in noisy surroundings; Luna still replies by voice.

welcome.title: Ready to practise?
welcome.description: Luna simulates the follow-up telehealth consultation so you can practise the questions you may be asked. This simulation does not assess your eligibility or order a kit.
steps: Check your microphone and find a quiet place.
Practise answering questions about your age, screening history and symptoms.
Review your summary to prepare for the real telehealth consultation.
welcome.chatStep: Use text mode in noisy surroundings; Luna will still answer aloud.
welcome.voiceNote: Allow your browser to access your microphone when prompted.
welcome.chatNote: No microphone access is needed. Keep your device audio on to hear Luna.

complete.title: Practice completed
complete.description: Your practice call has ended. Review your summary to see your answers and what you can prepare before contacting the clinic.

live.ringHelp: Listen to the phone ringing and wait for the call to be answered.
live.speakHelp: Speak clearly when you are ready.
live.typeHelp: Type your response below, then select Send.
live.speakingHelp: Listen before responding. You can speak when it is your turn.
live.continueHelp: Please wait for the conversation to continue.

transcript.title: Call transcript
transcript.empty: Your conversation will appear here when you start practising.
